title: Car Rental Business Suite – Excel & Google Sheets Templates
descriptionHtml:
Run a small car or van rental from 8 Excel workbooks: quotes, booking calendar, deposits, fleet service and profit per vehicle. One payment of 29 dollars, no subscription, no macros.

Car Rental Business Suite is for an independent car rental business or a car-sharing host who pays for software every month and still cannot see which car loses money.

What you can do

  • Quote every rental above your own cost, with deposit and floor price check.
  • Find a free car for any dates and catch a double booking before pickup.
  • Bill return fees, chase damage claims and match each toll to its rental.
  • Release deposit holds on time and spot short or late payouts.
  • Know which car is due for service and which delivery runs pay.
  • Find the car that loses money, then keep, reprice or sell it.

What is inside: 8 workbooks

  • Enquiries, Quotes and Rate Card
  • Booking Calendar and Availability
  • Handover, Return, Fees and Damage
  • Deposits, Payments and Payouts
  • Fleet Register, Service and Renewals
  • Turnaround, Runs and Staff
  • Utilisation, Profit and Pricing
  • Finance, Replace-or-Sell and Owner Pay

Each workbook has 20 tables, 18 tools, 12 forms, 12 documents, 12 checklists, 34 ready message texts, 30 dashboard numbers, 22 charts and 6 gauges. Over the eight: 160 tables, 144 tools, 96 forms, 96 documents, 96 checklists, 272 messages, 240 dashboard numbers, 176 charts. Every part comes blank and filled with sample data from a fictional rental, so every page works on day one.

Who it is for

Owner-operators of a small car or van rental, and car-sharing hosts. A one-car host uses the same sheets with one vehicle.

Not for: online booking, a renter app, GPS tracking or e-signatures. You type or paste your data. The files hold booking references, dates, yes/no checks and amounts only.

How it works

  • Open the workbook for the job.
  • Replace the sample rows in the coloured input cells.
  • Read the dashboard and use the tools.

File format

Standard xlsx files for Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets and LibreOffice. No macros. No subscription. Formula cells are locked against accidental edits (no password). Dates follow your computer's regional format; the currency symbol changes in one cell. Rental software is usually billed every month, often per vehicle. This is 29 dollars, once.

Guarantee

If a file does not work as described, we fix it, replace it or refund you within 14 days.

Not legal, insurance or tax advice: check your local rules and insurance terms. Questions? See the FAQ.

What it does for you

  • Quote every rental above your own cost with a floor price check and a written quote
  • See which enquiries you lose, why, and what a slow first reply costs you
  • Find a free car for any dates and catch double bookings before pickup
  • Bill every return fee: extra miles, late minutes, refill and cleaning
  • Chase the oldest open damage claim first, with status and amounts only
  • Match every toll and ticket to the rental that had the car, admin fee added
  • Release each deposit hold on time and see the liability you hold now
  • Spot short-paid or late payouts from a car-sharing marketplace
  • Know which car is due for service and which renewal comes next
  • Price every delivery run so the zone that loses money gets repriced
  • Find the car that loses money, then decide keep, reprice or sell
  • See cash four weeks ahead and take a safe owner draw above your floor

Questions

Do I need special software, and does it work in Google Sheets?
No. The files are standard .xlsx files for Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets and LibreOffice (import the file into Google Sheets). There are no macros and no subscription.

Can I use my own currency and date format?
Yes. Dates follow your computer's regional format and the currency symbol changes in one cell. Fees, deposits, targets and cost settings are your own numbers, and every formula follows them.

I host one car on a car-sharing marketplace with no staff. Is it for me?
Yes. Use one vehicle and one channel in the same sheets: quotes, calendar, deposits, fees, service dates, profit per vehicle and the start-up case. Skip the staff and delivery sheets until you need them.

How do I start, and can I replace the sample data?
Each workbook comes blank and filled with sample data. Explore the sample copy, then type your own rows in the coloured input cells of the blank one. Start with the job that hurts most, since each workbook works on its own.

Does it take bookings or track my cars?
No. These are workbooks, not a web service or an app. You type or paste your data, and the calendar, alerts, fees and profit figures recalculate from it.

What if a file does not work?
If a file does not work as described, we fix it, replace it or refund you within 14 days.
